notes: The SICECO tariff combines a fixed fee per 12-hour period, energy price and a per-minute connected-time component.
A connection lasting more than 12 hours starts a new billing session and therefore charges a new fixed fee.
The official SICECO explanation states a 10 EUR fee when the payment procedure fails for a charge above 1 kWh.
The current regional service warns that Freshmile retail tariffs are no longer aligned with the tariffs communicated by the energy unions; such eMSP pricing must remain separate.
summaryLines: SICECO Côte-d'Or current published public tariff is machine-verified on the regional official tariff page.
Normal charge up to 22 kVA: 1.50 EUR per 12-hour period + 0.40 EUR/kWh + 0.005 EUR/minute.
Rapid charge up to 50 kVA: 2.00 EUR per 12-hour period + 0.50 EUR/kWh + 0.025 EUR/minute.
After more than 12 hours connected, a new billing session starts and a new fixed fee is charged.
A 10 EUR fee is published for payment-procedure failure when more than 1 kWh was charged.
Freshmile/eMSP retail pricing is not assumed to equal the SICECO published network tariff.
